title: The pipeline board
tagline: Every run, on its step, at a glance
intro: The pipeline board is a one-page picture of every piece of work in flight and the step each one has reached.

steps.say: You ask for the board and a small tool reads every run's notes to state which step each one is on.
do: python3 board.py . | jq '{generated, repo, runs: (.runs | length)}'

steps.say: It lists every active run once, tells feature work from maintenance work, and shows how far along the building step has come.

outro: Instead of walking folders and running commands, you find where every run stands in one glance.
